purpose: Kafka-to-DuckDB stream processing pipeline that ingests FortiMail network logs, builds a typed property graph of 9 entity types, computes 72 analytical signals per entity via graph algorithms and ML, and exposes the result through a REST and Arrow Flight SQL API.

domain_model.description: A typed, directed property graph where nodes are network entities (domain, host, subnet, URI, email, text, image, cluster, template) and edges capture co-occurrence, DNS structure, SPF delegation, and URI redirect chains.

bounded_contexts.name: Ingest
bounded_contexts.description: Owns the raw log parsing and entity extraction boundary; 'message' here means a FortiMail SMTP event, not a generic message.

ubiquitous_language.slot: A time-windowed gzip file containing one batch of FortiMail SMTP events
ubiquitous_language.message: A parsed FortiMail SMTP event (sender, recipients, IPs, URIs, spam flag)

bounded_contexts.name: Graph Store
bounded_contexts.description: Owns node and edge lifecycle; 'entity' here is a strongly-typed graph node, not a generic domain object.

ubiquitous_language.entity: A typed graph node identified by a canonical key (e.g. domain name, IP)
ubiquitous_language.traffic_history: Per-minute message count time series stored alongside each node
ubiquitous_language.flush: The atomic write of a NodeBuffer's accumulated records to DuckDB

bounded_contexts.name: Query API
bounded_contexts.description: Owns the read path; 'node' here is a REST resource representing an entity with all derived signals attached.

ubiquitous_language.node: A REST-level entity record combining base + derived + score columns
ubiquitous_language.warm cache: Pre-loaded in-memory snapshot of recently-active entities refreshed every 30 minutes

stack.runtime: Kubernetes (office cluster, prod namespace) — 32 pods: 27 graphdb consumers + API + Flight SQL + classifier scheduler + derived-refresh; each pod holds a single DuckDB file on a PVC

groups.name: Ingest
groups.description: Reads rawLog files from NFS, parses FortiMail messages, and fans out 9 entity types to Kafka topics.

groups.name: Graph Store
groups.description: 27 long-lived Kafka consumers, each owning one DuckDB file; collectively maintain the typed property graph.

groups.name: Analytics
groups.description: Compute derived signals and ML classifier scores on top of the raw graph.

groups.name: Query API
groups.description: REST API, Arrow Flight SQL server, and Python client SDK exposing the graph to external consumers.

actors.description: FortiMail email security appliances write rawLog gzip files to an NFS mount in per-day/per-slot directory structure.
Security analyst querying the graph via the CLI or client SDK to investigate spam campaigns.
Classifier scheduler that runs LightGBM inference every 30 minutes and retrains weekly.

components.name: Message Producer
components.description: Scans NFS rawLog directories for unprocessed slots, parses gzip FortiMail logs in parallel using spawned worker processes, and publishes parsed messages to the 'message' Kafka topic.

components.name: Entity Extraction
components.description: Consumes parsed messages from the 'message' topic, extracts 9 entity types via typed extractors, computes cluster membership via MinHash LSH, and routes entities to per-entity Kafka topics.

components.name: Metadata Archiver
components.description: Consumes the 'message' topic to persist per-message metadata (slot, sender, recipient counts) to message.duckdb.

components.name: Node Consumers
components.description: Nine Kafka consumers (domain, host, subnet, uri, email, text, image, content_template, cluster) each owning a dedicated DuckDB file; share a common NodeBuffer + NodeStore + traffic_history pattern from stoik.

components.name: Edge Consumers
components.description: Three Kafka consumers (emailed_with, association, cluster_member) maintaining edge tables in separate DuckDB files; edge-ew also runs SPF resolution and message_role edge writes.

components.name: Score Consumer
components.description: Subscribes to score.external_source and score.signal topics and persists external scores (FortiGuard, Spamhaus) and ML classifier signals to separate DuckDB files.

components.name: Enrichment Services
components.description: Domain enrichment pollers (WHOIS/RDAP, UCLT category, Certificate Transparency, SPF resolver, URI downloader + JS renderer) that run as separate processes, read domain snapshots, and push enrichment results to Redis queues consumed by the domain node consumer.

components.name: Derived Refresh
components.description: Long-running service that iterates entity types in round-robin, computing 7 tiers of derived signals (A: traffic aggregation, B-D: cross-DB joins and reputation lookups, E-F: static properties, G: graph algorithms — PageRank, label propagation, connected components — every 6 hours) and writing results to per-entity derived DuckDB files.

components.name: Classifier Scheduler
components.description: Time-based scheduler that runs LightGBM inference every 30 minutes (publishing spam probability scores to Kafka), retrains the spam classifier weekly from DuckDB-exported features, and runs dataset refresh daily.

components.name: GraphDB REST API
components.description: FastAPI server exposing 30+ REST endpoints for node lookup, neighbor traversal, path finding, subgraph extraction, search, bulk query, and metadata; backed by EdgePool (direct DuckDB connections to snapshot files) with an in-memory warm cache for hot entities.

components.name: Arrow Flight SQL Server
components.description: gRPC Arrow Flight SQL server backed by DuckDB-over-MinIO (Parquet snapshots in S3); provides bulk columnar query access to graph data for the classifier and admin tooling.

components.name: Graph Client
components.description: Python SDK and CLI (pip-installable) that wraps the REST API with typed methods, a local disk cache for subgraph results, and a Loki log streaming command.

flows.name: Log to Graph: NFS to DuckDB
flows.description: FortiMail rawLog files on NFS are parsed and fanned out to 9 entity-type Kafka topics, each consumed by a dedicated DuckDB writer.
flows.trigger: New rawLog slot appears on NFS mount at /mnt/nfs/rawLog/<day>/<slot>.gz

steps.action: scans NFS slot, spawns one process per rawLog file, parses gzip records
steps.data: parsed Message records (sender, recipients, IPs, URIs, CKM hashes)

steps.action: extracts 9 entity types + MinHash cluster keys, routes to entity topics
buffer per flush_interval, upsert with traffic history, write snapshot to MinIO

flows.name: Inference: Feature Matrix to Kafka Scores
flows.description: Classifier scheduler fetches entity features via Flight SQL, runs LightGBM, and publishes signed spam scores to Kafka for the score consumer to persist.

steps.action: queries entity feature views via Flight SQL, builds feature matrix
steps.data: pandas DataFrame with 72 signal columns per entity

steps.action: runs LightGBM inference, clips scores to [-1.0, 1.0]
steps.data: signed spam probability scores per entity key

steps.action: batches signal records, persists to signal.duckdb
steps.data: score rows (entity_type, entity_key, score, source, ts)

flows.name: Node Lookup via REST API
flows.description: Analyst queries a graph node by type + key; API checks warm cache, falls back to direct DuckDB snapshot, and joins base + derived tables.

steps.action: sends authenticated GET request with Bearer token + X-Graph-User header
validates Bearer token via AuthMiddleware, checks warm cache then EdgePool
merges base + derived + score fields, returns JSON
steps.data: entity JSON with 72 signals, scores, neighbors

flows.name: Tier G: Graph Algorithms Refresh
flows.description: Every 6 hours, derived-refresh loads the full emailed_with + association graphs into scipy sparse matrices and runs PageRank, label propagation, connected components, and BFS distance.

steps.action: attaches emailed_with + association + cluster_member snapshot DBs, loads COO arrays via fetchnumpy()
steps.data: sparse edge matrices (int32 COO, up to 100M+ edges)

steps.action: runs 6 algorithms (PageRank, label propagation, connected_components, community spam ratio, BFS distance, spam reachability) via scipy.sparse

failure_modes.trigger: NFS mount at /mnt/nfs/rawLog becomes unreachable (network partition, server reboot)

cascade.effect: statvfs() throws OSError; slot processing aborts; no retry loop — producer becomes idle

failure_modes.impact: Log ingestion halts; graph stops updating; entities age without new traffic data; downstream scoring and derived signals go stale
recovery: Manual intervention: restore NFS mount; message-producer auto-resumes on next scan cycle

failure_modes.trigger: Single Kafka broker becomes unavailable (single broker, no replication)

cascade.effect: publish_batch fails; messages lost (no retry queue)
consumer poll blocks; flush never triggered; DuckDB writes stop

failure_modes.impact: Full pipeline stall; all graph updates stop; already-persistent data survives in DuckDB but API returns increasingly stale data
recovery: Restart Kafka broker; consumers auto-reconnect via confluent-kafka; messages produced while broker was down are permanently lost

failure_modes.trigger: DuckDB lock contention: a node consumer holds a write lock when derived-refresh tries to attach the snapshot

cascade.effect: ATTACH fails after max_retries; that entity type's batch is skipped; derived signals grow stale
node lookups return increasingly stale derived signal values

failure_modes.impact: 72 derived signals (PageRank, spam propagation, community ID) stop updating; ML scoring accuracy degrades over hours to days
recovery: Automatic: next cycle retries the entity type; resolved when consumer completes its flush

failure_modes.trigger: MinIO becomes unreachable or snapshot refresh fails after a consumer flush

cascade.effect: opens stale Parquet files or no files; classifier reads old feature values
inference runs on stale features; scores degrade silently

failure_modes.impact: ML classifier accuracy degrades; spam entities may be missed or over-scored; no alert unless staleness is monitored
detection: none — no MinIO health check in current code
recovery: Restore MinIO; next consumer flush triggers snapshot refresh via lib/snapshot.py

evidence.note: stoik framework implements buffer-accumulate-flush-to-DuckDB pattern; NodeBuffer + NodeStore is the central abstraction for all 12 consumers
Classic producer/consumer with Kafka as the shared queue; 20+ topics separate producers from consumers

Starlette AuthMiddleware enforces Bearer token on all non-exempt paths; DuckDB-backed TokenStore with in-memory cache
EdgePool warm cache pre-loads recently-active entities (30min window); NodeStore keeps 200K-key in-memory known-key cache to skip DB lookups
stoik EntityCache with per-entity-type LRU limits (5K-15K entries) alongside warm tier

GET /health endpoint; sentinel runs as background thread querying Prometheus for per-process status flags; readiness + liveness probes in k8s manifest

DuckDB lock contention retry with exponential backoff in derived-refresh and NodeStore reconnect; WHOIS/RDAP service has retry on failed domains
EdgePool maintains long-lived read-only DuckDB connections to all snapshot files with per-connection locks; stoik FlightPool manages gRPC connections
9 typed node types with 8 edge relationship types; graph algorithms (PageRank, label propagation, BFS) applied over the graph structure

gaps.relevance: Kafka consumers have no dead-letter queue; malformed messages are logged and discarded
gaps.recommendation: Route deserialization failures to a dead-letter topic for offline inspection and replay

gaps.relevance: No trace IDs propagated from NFS ingest through Kafka through DuckDB write; correlation between API requests and specific data requires log scraping
gaps.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry spans on the slot-to-graph path; propagate slot_id as a correlation key

gaps.relevance: REST API has FastAPI path/query validation but no Pydantic model validation on most request bodies; /admin endpoints rely on middleware auth only
gaps.recommendation: Add Pydantic request models to bulk and admin endpoints

gaps.relevance: No rate limiting on any API endpoint; a runaway client or a slow query can saturate the DuckDB connection pool
gaps.recommendation: Add per-user rate limiting via FastAPI middleware (e.g., slowapi)

violations.anti_pattern: No circuit breaker on Kafka publish
violations.detail: All Kafka publish calls retry once on BufferError but have no circuit breaker; a sustained broker failure fills the retry loop indefinitely.

violations.anti_pattern: No retry on NFS mount failure
violations.detail: statvfs() failure aborts the slot and returns without retry; producer goes idle until next scan.

violations.anti_pattern: No health check on MinIO / Parquet snapshot freshness
violations.detail: Flight SQL silently serves stale Parquet if MinIO is down; no freshness check before classifier runs inference.

violations.anti_pattern: No Pydantic request model on bulk/admin endpoints
violations.detail: Bulk lookup and admin token endpoints do not validate request payload structure; type errors surface as 500 errors.

violations.anti_pattern: Manual SQL string interpolation in node lookup
violations.detail: _escape() replaces single quotes manually instead of using DuckDB parameterized queries; works correctly for current inputs but is fragile.

violations.anti_pattern: Hardcoded external IP for UCLT server
violations.detail: UCLT_SERVER = '173.243.138.91' should be an env var or ConfigMap entry.

violations.anti_pattern: print() in utility scripts and retention code
violations.detail: Utility scripts and retention modules use print() instead of structlog; breaks structured log pipeline in production.

violations.anti_pattern: No fallback when Redis is unreachable for enrichment queues
violations.detail: Redis connection failure in enrichment services raises an exception that propagates and kills the enrichment cycle; no fallback or graceful degradation.

recommendations.title: Add circuit breaker on Kafka publish and NFS access
recommendations.description: Wrap produce() calls with pybreaker; add retry loop with exponential backoff for NFS statvfs failure. Fixes the 'silent idle' failure mode where the producer stops without alerting.

recommendations.title: Add MinIO/Parquet freshness check before classifier inference
recommendations.description: Check Parquet file mtimes before running inference; abort if any entity type's snapshot is older than 2 hours. Prevents stale-feature scoring from silently degrading model quality.

recommendations.title: Add rate limiting and Pydantic request models to REST API
recommendations.description: Add slowapi per-user rate limiting middleware; add Pydantic BaseModel request schemas to bulk and admin endpoints. Prevents accidental API flooding and surfaces malformed payloads as 422 instead of 500.

recommendations.title: Move hardcoded UCLT IP to env var or ConfigMap
recommendations.description: Replace UCLT_SERVER literal with os.environ.get('UCLT_SERVER', ...) and add to graphdb ConfigMap.

recommendations.title: Replace print() with structlog in utility scripts
recommendations.description: Replace print() calls with structlog logger.info() so retention and support scripts emit structured JSON compatible with the log pipeline.
